name: Tyrion
canonNotes: Defender of Ulthuan, the greatest living warrior of the High Elves and descendant of Aenarion; twin brother of Teclis.
Devoted champion of the Everqueen Alarielle; the Curse of Aenarion lingers in his bloodline.
voiceNotes: Noble, confident and gallant; speaks of duty to Ulthuan and honour in battle.
Courteous to worthy allies, disdainful of the dishonourable.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
